violations.description: Missing CI workflow configuration (no automated workflows or test execution in CI).
violations.evidence: No GitHub Actions workflows or CI configuration files exist in the repository.
violations.recommendation: Add a GitHub Actions workflow under .github/workflows/ to run tests and linters on pull requests and pushes.

violations.description: Committed deployment configuration files contain hardcoded absolute home paths (/home/ubuntu/microblog).
violations.recommendation: Parameterize paths in configuration templates or use relative/environment-based path resolution.

violations.description: .gitignore does not ignore .env files used by python-dotenv.
violations.evidence: .env is not matched by .gitignore rules (config.py loads .env via dotenv).

violations.description: No code linter or formatter (such as flake8, black, ruff, or pylint) is configured anywhere in the project.
violations.evidence: No linter configuration files or pre-commit hooks are present.
violations.recommendation: Configure ruff or flake8/black in pyproject.toml or setup.cfg, and run it in CI.
